title: Hall link v1: shared definitions
description: The shapes the other files of hall-link-v1 refer to (`common.schema.json#/definitions/<name>`). The server half is built by the OpenPairings plugins `openpairings_nunki` and `openpairings_polis` (in the Nunki and Polis repositories); the device half by `Nunki.Join`/`Nunki.Link` and `Polis.Join`/`Polis.Link`. Not a message of its own.

version.description: The protocol version. A server that does not speak it answers 409 on join and `refused` `version` on the line.

id.description: An OpenPairings database id: a positive whole number.

device.description: The device's own id, made once per data folder and never changed. Joining the same tournament again from the same device replaces its key.

key.description: The device's secret for one tournament: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding. Kept in the device's state file and nowhere else; travels only in `hello`, never in a URL or a log.

code.description: A one-time pairing code as it appears in a pairing link. New codes are 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters); a reader must take any non-empty run of these characters, since codes made before the unification (16 base32 characters) stay valid until they expire.

new_code.description: A pairing code as every server makes it now: 32 random bytes, base64url, no padding.

tournament_ref.description: Which tournament the line is for. The name may change; the device updates what it shows from every `welcome`.

room_names.description: The tournament's rooms by name (OpenPairings: Settings, Rooms), to choose from. May be empty. A server older than rooms leaves the key out, and the device then treats `room` as free text.

player.description: One player on a board, as the printed pairing list has them.

spoken.description: As said aloud: `First Last`. Nunki reads it; Polis does not print it.

rating.description: By the tournament's rating method; 0 is unrated and is left off the sheet.

score.description: The score coming INTO the round, as the pairing list prints it: `2`, `2.5`.

board.description: A label, not a number: `12`, a team board `3.1`, a shared fixed table `1001/1002`.

bye.description: `bye` when there is no black player, otherwise null.

room.description: Polis only, and only when the tournament has rooms: the name of the room the board is in, or empty for a board in none. Left out otherwise.

round_payload.description: The latest published round, cut to the device's share of it. The same shape for every hall app; a round that is not public is never sent, and neither is one older than the last sent.

locale.description: The tournament owner's language: what the sheets are printed and the pairings read in, unless the device says otherwise.

rev.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the payload's JSON without `rev`. Changes exactly when something sent changes.

room.description: Nunki only: present when the announcer stands in a room, and `boards` holds only that room's boards.

selection.description: Polis only: present when the station prints part of the round, and `boards` holds only that part.

room.description: The room's name when the station stands in a real room, otherwise empty.
